name: browser-use
headline: dotclaude - Automate Development Workflows
short_description: dotclaude is a Claude Code configuration that automates development workflows from issue definition to implementation and review. It enhances Claude Code with custom commands for agentic programming. Ideal for operations teams looking to streamline coding tasks and improve efficiency.
author: Hey-Diga

sections.overview:
dotclaude is a Claude Code configuration that automates the entire development lifecycle through three core commands: /gh-issue for research and issue creation, /start-working-on-issue for end-to-end implementation with testing and PR generation, and /review-pr-comments for addressing feedback. It enhances Claude Code with reusable skills that handle environment setup, code execution, linting, type checking, and git workflows automatically. The tool executes proper git conventions, runs test suites, and integrates with GitHub CLI, making it ideal for teams looking to reduce manual development overhead and maintain consistency across coding tasks.
Automating feature implementation from GitHub issues to merged PRs
Addressing PR review feedback without manual intervention
Creating well-researched GitHub issues with implementation context
Running automated testing and CI/CD diagnostics
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Hey-Diga/dotclaude`
sections.usage:
```
I'm setting up dotclaude to automate my development workflow. Here's my current setup: [COMPANY] is a [INDUSTRY] company. Our team uses [TECHNOLOGY] for development. I need to automate [SPECIFIC TASKS]. Can you help me configure dotclaude with the right commands and workflows?
```
Copy

```
# dotclaude Configuration for [COMPANY] Development Workflow
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
